description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama, Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800 (23/0904)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and legal status of various land plots in different locations. The content is entirely focused on land registration and property rights, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
